name: Codeep
author: Vlado Ivankovic
description: Codeep in the bar: whether it is idle, working or waiting for you, today's and this week's usage, and a field that opens Codeep in a terminal with your prompt.

barWidget.description: Codeep's mark in the bar with a state cue, and a panel with usage, running sessions and an Ask field.

schema.label: Usage refresh while the panel is open (seconds)
How often to look for running Codeep (seconds)
Run unattended (--yolo)
schema.description: Codeep started from the Ask field runs without stopping to ask for approval. Off by default.

schema.label: Hide when nothing runs
schema.description: Take the mark off the bar while no Codeep is running. Open the panel with: omarchy-shell codeep.agent toggle

schema.label: Animate while working
schema.description: Step the mark while Codeep works. Off holds one chevron lit instead of moving. The shell's own reduced-motion switch is honoured where it exists.
